entries.name: Wand Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your damage with Wands by $s1%.

entries.name: Arcane Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit with Arcane spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Channeling
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a $m2% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

entries.name: Arcane Subtlety
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by $s2 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Magic Absorption
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all your resistances by $s2 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore $s1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

entries.name: Arcane Concentration
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by $/10;12536s1%.

entries.name: Arcane Resilience
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to $s1% of your Intellect.

entries.name: Arcane Geometry
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by $m1 yards.

entries.name: Arcane Impact
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Arcane Blast
entries.descriptionTemplate: Blasts the target with energy, dealing $s1 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by $400573s1% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by $400573s2%. Effect stacks up to $400573u times and lasts $400573d or until any other damage spell is cast.

entries.name: Arcane Shielding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by $m1% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Counterspell
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for ${$m1/1000} sec.

entries.name: Arcane Meditation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Missile Barrage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a $m1% chance, and your Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a ${$m1/2}% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by $400589s1%, reduce the Mana cost by $400589s3%, and missiles fire every ${$m2/10}.1 sec.

entries.name: Presence of Mind
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Arcane Mind
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Intellect by $m1% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by $m2%.

entries.name: Arcane Instability
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your spells by $m1% and your critical strike chance by $m2%.

entries.name: Arcane Power
entries.descriptionTemplate: For the next $d, your spells deal $s1% more damage while costing $s2% more mana to cast.

entries.name: Wake of Fire
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by ${$s1/-1000} sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within $1312934d by $m2%.

entries.name: Incineration
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Fireball
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball and Frostfire Bolt spells by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Ignite
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional $m1% of your spell's damage over $412538d.

entries.name: Flame Throwing
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your Fire spells by $s1 yards.

entries.name: Impact
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Fire spells a $m1% chance to stun the target for $12355d.

entries.name: Burning Soul
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Fire spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by $s2%.

entries.name: Improved Flamestrike
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Pyroblast
entries.descriptionTemplate: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes $s1 Fire damage and an additional $o2 Fire damage over $d.

entries.name: Improved Scorch
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Scorch spell has a $m1% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by $22959s1% and lasts $22959d, stacking up to $22959u times.

entries.name: Improved Fire Ward
entries.descriptionTemplate: Causes your Fire Ward to have a $s1% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

entries.name: Hot Streak
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for $400625d. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by $400625s1%, stacking up to $400625s2 times.

entries.name: Master of Elements
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund $s1% of their base mana cost.

entries.name: Critical Mass
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Blast Wave
entries.descriptionTemplate: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for $s1 Fire damage, and Dazing them for $s2% reduced movement speed for $d.

entries.name: Fire Power
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Combustion
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by $28682s1%.  This effect lasts until you have caused $n non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

entries.name: Frost Warding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by $s1%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a $s2% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.

entries.name: Improved Frostbolt
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Elemental Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Ice Shards
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Permafrost
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by $s1% and reduces the target's speed by an additional $s2%.

entries.name: Improved Frost Nova
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Chill effects a $s1% chance to Freeze the target for $12494d.

entries.name: Piercing Ice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Frost Channeling
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by $s1% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by $s2%.

entries.name: Ice Lance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deals $s1 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals $s2% increased damage to Frozen targets.

entries.name: Improved Blizzard
entries.descriptionTemplate: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by $m1% for $12484d.

entries.name: Arctic Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your Frostbolt and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Ice Block
entries.descriptionTemplate: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for $d, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

entries.name: Shatter
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Cone of Cold
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.descriptionTemplate: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

entries.name: Fingers of Frost
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Chill effects a $s2% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next $m1 $lspell:spells; cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts $400669d.

entries.name: Winter's Chill
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Frost damage spells a $m2% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by $12579s1% for $12579d. Stacks up to $s1 times.

entries.name: Ice Barrier
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly shields you, absorbing $s1 damage. Lasts $d. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
